freeze_scope: Rule classification and bounded validation contract; not a universal product recommender, construction approval or website release.

classification_policy.GREEN: Executable only inside verified matching evidence scope.
classification_policy.YELLOW: Explanation only; cannot score, rank, filter or choose tools.
classification_policy.RED: No automatic judgement; retained for traceability and prohibited-inference documentation.

execution_contract.empty_candidate_result: No verified combination for the supplied conditions; verify the specific manufacturer system.

predicate_language.units: Lengths in mm after exact unit normalization; no rounding into an allowed range.
predicate_language.null_semantics: Missing/null operands produce unknown except is_null. all: false if any false, true only if all true; any: true if any true, false only if all false; otherwise unknown. Unknown never means validation passed.
predicate_language.guard_semantics: evidence.scope_matches must compare manufacturer, model/generation, region, material, drilling method and exact accessory configuration for every referenced fact; it may not be inferred from model-name similarity. Conflict-bearing facts cannot be verified.
predicate_language.action_semantics: A true condition triggers its recommendation action. False only means this violation was not established; it does not approve a tool. null conditions are disabled. No YELLOW/RED action may be synthesized from reason text.
predicate_language.technical_checks_semantics: passed may be supplied only when all applicable material, method, diameter, interface, length, dust and supply checks have verified matching evidence; missing or conflicting checks remain unknown. It does not assess the site.

rules.reason: Mechanism and interface are separate dimensions.
limitations: Does not infer mechanism from a marketing title or assign missing tool properties.

rules.reason: No-impact drill is not a default concrete hammer-drilling option in the verified evidence.
limitations: Editorial policy, not a universal impossibility claim; no complete pure-rotation system verified.

rules.reason: Some hammer drills explicitly support concrete; complete product and bit evidence is still necessary.
limitations: HP2010N 20 mm is one model's capacity, not a category threshold or performance guarantee.
No complete hammer-drill dust system was added.

rules.reason: Rotary hammers are relevant concrete candidates; material alone does not determine the best tool.
limitations: Does not convert concrete into an unconditional rotary-hammer recommendation.

rules.reason: A diameter outside an explicit, matching model/material/method range cannot pass that capability check.
limitations: Never uses optimum, core, ambiguous masonry or cross-region fields as this range.
Not being excluded is not positive suitability approval.

rules.reason: An optimum range can explain a model's intended fit; maximum capacity and optimum are different fields.
limitations: No automatic score, ranking or exclusion based on optimum range.

rules.reason: Native interface mismatch requires a separately approved adapter configuration.
limitations: V0.1 does not automatically support adapters or claim that every adapter is prohibited.
Interface equality alone cannot certify material, mode or dimensions.

rules.reason: Specific SDS-Plus and SDS-Max optimum ranges overlap; interface alone cannot choose a winner.
limitations: Examples are model comparisons, not universal class boundaries or automatic ranking.

rules.reason: Published capacities distinguish bit/method families; V0.1 ordinary hammer-bit checks cannot validate special methods.
limitations: A through-hole made with an ordinary solid bit is not automatically a breakthrough-bit method.
Unknown method must be clarified rather than inferred.

rules.reason: A documented working-length or attachment limit is a necessary constraint.
limitations: Each compared limit must be verified for the exact configuration.
An unknown limit cannot be filled from total length; unknown comparisons cannot pass.
No universal extra depth allowance or interface-upgrade threshold.

rules.reason: Hole count describes workload. A runtime claim belongs to its published dimensions, battery and test conditions.
limitations: No guaranteed runtime, hole-volume extrapolation, duty-cycle or hole-count threshold.

rules.reason: Power preference filters technically checked candidates; it does not establish engineering capability.
limitations: This filtering is an explicit product policy, supported by evidence that cordless SDS-Max exists.
No preference retains both; an empty result asks for verification rather than changing the preference.

rules.reason: Anchor diameter, depth, installation and cleaning require the current selected anchor system instructions.
limitations: No anchor design, load rating, embedment calculation or generic cleaning count.
Dust capture does not establish permission to omit anchor-hole cleaning.

rules.reason: Utilities, reinforcement, prestressing and unknown obstructions require site verification or engineering judgement.
limitations: No automatic declaration that a location is safe or that reinforcement may be cut.
Human content must require stopping at an unknown obstruction; old guide is not a current approval.

rules.reason: Dust collection and gripping requirements belong to the verified tool/accessory system.
limitations: No automatic respiratory protection decision or country-wide compliance statement.
HEPA, extractor class, capture rate and exposure are distinct; filter condition and setup matter.

rules.reason: Material-specific instructions cannot be applied while the material is unknown.
limitations: Scope policy supported by the manufacturer's material/mode distinctions.
Known non-concrete materials remain outside this job; no material identification is inferred.

rules.reason: No universal Drill/Hammer Drill/SDS-Plus/SDS-Max crossover is established; official examples contradict rigid class boundaries.
limitations: All universal numeric crossover fields remain absent.

rules.reason: No universal depth, hole-count or aspect-ratio upgrade threshold was established.
limitations: Model-specific attachment limits are constraints, not universal tool upgrades.

rules.reason: No validated formula converts W, V, Ah, BPM or J into universal hole diameter or drilling time.
limitations: Published battery compatibility requirements remain configuration-specific; they are not a performance formula.

rules.reason: Ambiguous fields, regions, generations and drilling methods cannot be merged into a maximum-capacity answer.
limitations: Keep conflicting observations with their scopes; effective disputed values remain null.
Do not select whichever published value is larger, smaller or more convenient.
